resources.string: Review an interrupted restore
Check a restore that was interrupted in this profile. No recovery key is needed to review its saved result. This does not repeat the restore or choose Keep or Discard for you.
Checking the saved restore record and its result…
This review comes from the saved restore record. These counts describe the saved selection, not an inspection of its contents. Keeping or discarding the profile needs your new choice.
No interrupted restore was found for this profile.
Return to the profile where you started the restore, and try again when it is ready. No new restore choice was made.
TaffyGo could not check interrupted restores. No new restore choice was made. Try again when this profile is ready.
The earlier restore was already kept. Its profile is available in Profiles. Your current profile has not changed.
The earlier restore was already discarded, and its new profile is no longer present. Your current profile and backup file have not changed.
Review closed. Closing a review does not repeat, keep or discard a restore.
The saved record does not establish a completed restore. TaffyGo cannot offer Keep or Discard from this record. Do not repeat the restore to try to finish it.
The saved review details are missing. TaffyGo cannot offer Keep or Discard without them. Do not repeat the restore to try to finish it.
The saved restore uses a storage format this version cannot safely check. No Keep or Discard choice is available. Do not repeat the restore to try to finish it.
TaffyGo could not establish the result of the earlier restore. No Keep or Discard choice is available. Do not repeat the restore to try to finish it.
The saved restore is still in use, has changed, or could not be checked safely. No Keep or Discard choice is available. Try reviewing it again when this profile is ready.
Restore a backup
Restore the contents of a backup into a new profile. Your current profile stays separate. You review the saved selection before anything is restored.
Restored profile
New profile name
The file was checked with your recovery key. Review its saved selection to continue.
Review backup
Review what will be restored
Destination: %1$s (new profile)
Saved selection
Items to restore: %1$d
Saved removals: %1$d
Items already present: %1$d
Newer items kept: %1$d
Items kept removed: %1$d
Items needing another choice: %1$d
This selection needs another choice before it can be restored. Nothing has been restored.
Confirm selection and prepare
Reading the saved selection and preparing a new profile…
Preparing and checking the selected contents…
The selected contents are prepared and checked. Restore them into the new profile?
Restore into the new profile
Restoring the selected contents. This step cannot be cancelled…
The selected contents were restored and checked. The new profile is still hidden. Review this result, then choose whether to keep or discard it.
Keep this profile
Discard this profile
Discard the new profile?
This deletes only the new profile. Your current profile and the backup file stay unchanged.
Back to review
Finishing your choice and checking the result…
Your choice did not complete. The new profile is still hidden. You can choose again when you are ready.
The restored profile is now available in Profiles. Your current profile has not changed.
The new profile was deleted. Your current profile and the backup file were not changed.
Nothing was restored. The new profile is still hidden and needs cleanup. You can discard it below. Your current profile was not changed.
TaffyGo could not confirm the result. Your current profile was not changed. Do not repeat the restore to try to finish it.
This backup could not be prepared for restoration. No restored profile is available.
Restore preparation stopped. Your current profile and the backup file were not changed.
